notes.title: An update on Game Stability & Crashes 📣🎮
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!👋

We'd like to share an [b]update on the game's health[/b] and technical stability.

We've received [b]multiple reports of the game crashing[/b], often without specific input. 🕹️

We don't have a fix (yet), but ⬇️ [u][b]we recommend you do the actions below[/b][/u] ⬇️

[olist]
[*] [b]Update the game[/b] to the latest version
[*] Verify the [b]integrity of the game's files[/b] in the Steam Library settings
[*] Update your [b]GPU driver[/b] to the latest one
[*] Clear your [b]DirectX / Nvidia shader cache - [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/165h4pv/constant_shader_recompilation_steps_to_clear_the/]Instructions HERE[/url][/b] (or in doubt your favorite AI!)
[/olist]
If you want some more details ... 👇👇👇

We've investigated the issue and identified the following points ... 🕵️

[list]
[*] ⛓️Many crashes involve the "Swap Chain" - a mechanism that renders the final images on screen
[*] 🐞These crashes point to the error "[b]0x887a0005[/b]" - a communication error with the GPU
[/list]
This indicates a [b]driver conflict[/b]. 💥

Unfortunately, these are processes we have little control over - if any. 😟

This seems to be linked to the latest [b]Windows 11 update (24H2)[/b]. 🖥️

We hope to find a solution soon - please bear with us! 🙏

notes.title: Price Update for Release
notes.notes:
We have important news about the game price for Songs of Silence as we approach its full release on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox.

First and foremost, let us express our deepest gratitude to everyone who has supported Songs of Silence so far. Your passion, feedback, and dedication have been instrumental in shaping the game into what it is today. With your support, our vision is now a reality, and we are forever honored and thankful.

As an independent studio striving to make our mark, we've been reflecting on how to bring Songs of Silence to an even wider audience. One key insight from Early Access is the profound impact of pricing on accessibility. 

Our research suggests that reducing the price, as a game transitions from Early Access to full release, is a step rarely, if ever, taken in the industry. Despite the uncertainty that comes with venturing into uncharted territory, this decision aligns with our core values and our commitment to our community.  

Therefore, we will be adjusting the base price of Songs of Silence from $39.99 to $29.99 for the 1.0 release, with corresponding changes to regional prices. 

We believe this new price point strikes the right balance between honoring the game's value and making it attainable for more players worldwide. Our goal is to welcome as many people as possible into the richly crafted world we've created.

We understand this change may come as a surprise, especially to our early supporters who purchased the game at the original price. Please know that this decision was made with the long-term vision of growing our community and ensuring the game's success. 

We value your opinions and invite you to share your thoughts with us. We've set up[url=https://forms.gle/FcqhkXg4FgNU5HGR6][b] a contact form where you can reach out directly[/b][/url], and we'll do our best to respond in the coming days and weeks.

We're incredibly excited about what the future holds for Songs of Silence and remain committed to delivering ongoing updates and new content post-launch. Your continued support fuels our passion, and we can't wait to embark on this next chapter together.

With heartfelt appreciation,
The Chimera Entertainment Team

[h2]🥳 We have a 1.0 Release Date - Nov 13! 🥳[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/369dacd0a7c63eeca9921d8d3bdbc2f4aa350b4d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/c113e1d25abddaa19a1da9e9d1579f4086e1f60c.png[/img]

That said, let's continue.

This is the first instalment of the [b][i]Road to Launch[/i][/b] series. It's a special moment ✨ as much of this was driven by [b]YOU[/b], our dedicated community! Today and in the coming weeks - we’ll take you through the significant milestones we’ve achieved together, thanks to your feedback, ideas, and support.

[h2]⚔️ An Overview of the Road to Launch! ⚔️[/h2]

Long ago, the Chimeras lived together in harmony. Then everything changed when we went into Early Access... [i]Wait what?[/i] 

Yes. That's where the story starts. The moment we went into Early Access, the day where we started talking to the Community Non-stop. 

You see, the moment we released, there was a small moment of hype. We celebrated, drank some apple juice, and were happy. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/3c3a8fccfbdc791c5beb8e64216fe6b707dd60d5.png[/img]

[h2]😱 Then the reviews came in... 😱[/h2]
[i]Some negative[/i] - Immediately, we got our toolboxes out. What was the issue? We are checking, reading, party mode long forgotten. There it is. Japanese Characters in unrelated translations. Oh no. 
How did this happen? Doesn't matter. What does is to listen. Immediately we make a post about it. 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195410/view/4182234368465978335?l=english
2 hours later we deliver the fix. But the damage was done. We struggle with the visibility. What a bummer. People have questions. [i]Why the negative reviews? What's up with the price? Why is the Crusade so overpowered?? Why did we lock everything??? [/i]All valid questions. Questions we answered the next day.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195410/view/4186738601581408974?l=english
And for everyone coming in after that, we made an edited version together with our Creative Director Alex, and our Publishing team. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tWqqsceBy9I

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h2]🔥 Hotfix 2.0: Early Unlocks and Faster Battles![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195410/view/4186738601585741984?l=english
Your feedback on the game’s pacing and accessibility sparked one of our earliest updates, and we knew we had to respond swiftly. With Hotfix 2.0, we introduced a series of quality of life improvements to streamline your experience.

✨ [b]Encyclopedia Revamp[/b]: We improved the UX/UI, offering clearer explanations for how to unlock content in Skirmish and Multiplayer. No more guessing—you’ll know exactly how to access your favorite heroes and armies!

✨ [b]Unlocks from the Start[/b]: We made sure that from the get-go, every faction starts with two hero vocations unlocked and the 4min Chess Fate is now available to all. No more slow starts—get into the action faster!

✨[b] Speed Up Battles[/b]: Yes, some battles felt slow. We understand. So, we added the speed up option! Now you can engage in combat at 2X and 4X speeds, so you can swiftly outmaneuver your enemies or experience quicker, more intense clashes!

✨[b] Exit & Load During Battle[/b]: This one almost everyone complained about. We didn't even think of it, before you voiced it - but you showed us why it made sense. So we’ve added the ability to exit and load games mid-battle for ultimate flexibility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h2]🛡️ Hotfix 3: Movement, Maps, and Deeper Immersion[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195410/view/6041096475587860516?l=english
The next phase of fixes was all about perfecting the flow and feel of the game. Especially Map 2 received a lot of backslash. The stealth mission we had invisioned did not work as intended, as the Map Terrain did not support it very well. So together with some bugs, we started a big rework.

✨[b] Movement UI[/b]: We’ve improved the movement meter and added better visual cues for hero movement points on their portraits—making it easier to plan your moves.

✨[b] Map 02 Tutorial Rework[/b]: Eila’s Guidance, and stealth mechanics, got a makeover, together with the whole Map 2 terrain. Now, learning how to navigate Map 02 feels smoother and more intuitive.

✨[b] Zoom-in Battle Depth[/b]: Oh, this one was a joy to bring. We’ve deepened the zoom in battles, so you can now appreciate the finer details of your armies clashing in the heat of battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h2]⚔️ Update 0.5.5: The Big Balancing Overhaul![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195410/view/4270057097450005006?l=english
You may ask, why did we switch from Hotfix to Update? For clarity, honestly. From that point, we weren't running around with our pants on fire anymore. We could plan. Hotfixes were helpful to communicate the urgency that came with Early Access launch. But now things had stabilized. :) 

Especially in our 0.5.5 Update, which brought in a big list of Balancing changes. We could not call that a Hotfix anymore, since we had adjusted so much. 
Let's also not go into details here. If checking out numbers is your think, feel free to read the Steam post, otherwise this would take a lot of space. :D 

⚖️ Crusade Nerf, Old Race Buff: The mighty Crusade received some well-deserved nerfs to balance their dominance, while the ancient Old Race has gained some much-needed buffs to bring them back into the competitive scene. This of course still isn't perfect, and we're adjusting the numbers all the time. Once day, we will have it perfectly. Once day...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h2]🏰 Update 0.6: Community Feedback FTW![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195410/view/4353376227583508897?l=english
This update was all about you—the players! Together with our Roadmap Features such as the Movement System rework, or Steam deck support, we took your feedback and built upon it, introducing some of the most highly requested changes.

🏰 [b]Garrison Aid in Sieges[/b]: You wanted it, and we thought it made sense. Your Garrison now joins the fight when you are besieged. Because why wouldn't they? This is a game-changer for early-game sieges, making defense more strategic and impactful.

🎵 [b]Music Settings for Streamers[/b]: Love the soundtrack? Now you can choose whether the music keeps playing when you switch windows—perfect for streamers and multi-taskers alike.

⚔️[b] AI Army Management[/b]: The AI is now smarter when managing units—healing in safe locations and leaving garrison troops for protection. Plus, allied armies can now move through occupied locations, optimizing their movement.

🌿 [b]Visual Overhauls[/b]: We updated the Wilderness biome on large maps with more details and procedural decoration. Whether it’s windmills or vegetation, the world feels more alive than ever!

✨ [b]Light Veins Visual Update[/b]: Sharper, brighter, and more visible—Light Veins on the map now stand out beautifully.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h2]🎖️ Update 0.7: Choose Your Next Hero![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195410/view/4613462277091416632?l=english
Getting Erudite 3 times in a row, or never getting a Highlord when you started with the Hierophant (trust me, I speak from experience) It feels.. unfair. Especially if your enemy is putting out Arbiters one after another. A lot of you have requested to be able to choose your next hero. This was something more complicated to implement, so it took its sweet time. But for 0.7 we made it, and it enhanced the gameplay A LOT.

✨[b] Choose Your Hero[/b]: One of the most requested features is here—now, you can choose your next hero in single-player skirmish and multiplayer! Say goodbye to getting the same hero multiple times in a row. We agree—it’s neat!

🤼[b] Co-op Multiplayer[/b]: It's still in v.01, so it's not at its full potential yet. We see the vision already: Exchanging resources and Armies - that would be neat. But that system is overly complicated, it would add more resource management, and our backend is not made for it. So we delivered the first version - shared vision and friendly locations, so we can add up on it based on your feedback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h2]🧠 Update 0.8: Difficulty Levels & Community-Driven Enhancements[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195410/view/4656248375959274623?l=english
Last Update everyone! Not forever - for Early Access. That's it. Week after week we've been checking the feedback, discussed it with the team and implemented what made sense. It's been a ride - whew. But 0.8 was something important to deliver, and it brought some other great improvements!

🧠[b] AI Improvements[/b]: From better handling of lootwagons to making neutral AI more aggressive, we’ve improved how the AI behaves in various scenarios. They now traverse purgatories more effectively and no longer leave isolated armies wandering aimlessly.

🗺️ [b]Strategy Map Zoom-In & UI Toggle[/b]: Whenever you want to admire the beautiful locations, you can now zoom in closer on the map!

⚔️ [b]Quest Unlock Adjustments[/b]: Grinding be gone! Now, you only need to win 1 game to unlock quests, instead of 3—making progression smoother and faster.

[b]🚪 MP Lobby Exit Confirmation[/b]: We’ve added an exit confirmation popup when leaving the Multiplayer Lobby, making sure you don’t accidentally quit the game after waiting for that perfect match.

📜 [b]In-Game News Screen:[/b] Meet our friendly Kobold! He’s here to give you the latest news and updates right inside the game, so you’re always in the loop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h2]❓Where is 0.9❓[/h2]
Good Question! We got what we need. 

We really, like [i]really[/i] want to launch this game. And we think with all your feedback we're just at the right spot. So let's be a bit more patient, and wait for 1.0.

[h2]🛡️ The Road Ahead[/h2]
As we continue our journey toward launch, we are thrilled to have you by our side. Your insights, feedback, and suggestions have been invaluable in shaping Songs of Silence into the epic experience it’s becoming. Each update marks a milestone in our shared adventure, and we can’t wait to show you what’s next.

Thank you for being a part of this journey. 

[url=https://discord.gg/songs-of-silence-1068472676127100988][b]Join us in our Discord[/b][/url], be sure to grab the Private Tester role to participate in discussions and playtests. 

Let’s continue crafting this world together!

⚔️ Join the Battle, Shape the Future! ⚔️

Already teased in our Livestreams (what, you didn’t know we have a Twitch channel? Check it out here: https://www.twitch.tv/songsofsilence ) we have been working on some nice improvements and are happy to bring you our first major update from our Early Access Roadmap!

[h2] [Roadmap Feature] Movement System Rework[/h2]
Motivated by feedback from our dear Community, and the team, we aimed to improve the UX and quality of live. It is now easier to move & sneak past units on the map, as we adjusted the control zones. notes.title: New patch coming today - Battle Speed & Main Menu | Speed Chess Mode | Bugfixes
notes.notes:
[b]Hello! [/b]

Firstly, a thank you! 

We’ve been live for about 48 hours now, and we’re so happy to see so many people buying, playing, and enjoying the game. Your feedback, good or bad, is important to us, and we are listening to it all. We’re about to drop the first hotfix, addressing some of the comments and constructive criticism we’ve received over the last two days. 

We are listening, and we are grateful to you all for bearing with us during the early access period and providing us with so much helpful information. As you can see from this patch, we’re working hard to implement your feedback and improve the game as quickly and thoroughly as possible. 

[b]But let's move on to the details of the update. [/b]
In terms of gameplay mechanics, two clear criticisms became apparent to us: the way content is unlocked for Skirmish and Multiplayer and how that is communicated in-game, and the inability to quit directly from a battle or to speed up the battle’s progress. 

This first patch, which will be released within the next 24 hours, addresses both issues and adds the Korean language pack!

[b]Content Unlocks[/b]
For the unlocking of content, we’ve both improved the UX/UI around the encyclopedia quests you need to complete to unlock content, and we’ve unlocked two heroes from each faction to play with right from the start. 

For the Crusade, that’s the Purgatory Shepherd, a ‘vocation’ or sub-class of the Arbiter Hero type - this awe-inspiring leader ravages entire armies with his destructive powers while commanding a particularly powerful Purgatory; and the Void Herald vocation for the Kantor class. This Kantor belongs to the Congregation of Dhana's Love and specializes in strong defense, healing, and building temples.

The Old Race gets the Medico vocation for the Monodika class - this Monodika has developed strong healing abilities, and her capital city allows the immediate recruitment of Harbinger units. In addition, the eyeless ones will have access to the Stonesinger vocation for the Konstruktor hero. A Konstruktor of very rare talent. His workshops, the fabled Konstruktoriums, are more developed than normal and immediately available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/31b73eb785cf507220af6544405e4d820a273845.png[/img]

The UX/UI improvements to the Encyclopedia make it much easier to understand what you should do next to unlock the content you’re looking for, as shown in the screenshots below. We know that it felt a little frustrating not to be able to find this information easily previously - this makes it much clearer what’s needed to get to the next unlock stage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/31d7a9edbb349beed4cc62803fa320b0a7b01f8c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/c5a403f5b098c91d8e21a46ae8c785eba1820122.png[/img]

[b]Battle Speed[/b]
Sometimes, you might want to save the enemy some blushes by fast-forwarding a battle where you’re embarrassing them. Now you can double or even quadruple the battle speed to deliver swift justice, or maybe save a few blushes of your own…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/8348a093277112f3500ae7b945a2cd4d786a317b.png[/img]

[b]Main Menu in Battle[/b]

We’ve also added the ability to be able to reload a previous save from the midst of battle, or to make a complete tactical withdrawal to the main menu if things are going really badly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/3c03ac71d9c95270d2867f7144a786b303ddbc30.png[/img]

[b]Speed Chess Mode[/b]
Finally, we have our new four-minute, time-limited turn mode unlocked from the first time you play the game; it's convenient if you’re engaging in multiplayer with a foe prone to going AFK or spending too much time perfecting their strategic decision-making.


[b]Stealth and Ambushes[/b]
We've seen that folks have been struggling with the stealth system introduced in Map Two. And maaaaaaybe it was a little harsh. So we're looking at a rework of how some of the stealth and ambush systems work to make them a little less brutal - this will be in a patch coming in next 24h!

But we're not going to leave you hanging over the weekend, either. We've implemented a small fix in this patch, which will increase the size of the forests you can hide in, giving Lorelai's army a better chance of sneaking past under the cover of the canopy. Good luck!

notes.title: Closed Beta Balancing Update: Old Race Version!
notes.notes:
Hi all! 
After our last Closed Beta update, we were able to gather a lot of feedback and suggestions. Especially our balancing needed another pass, and we've been working hard on fixing them! 

Perfectly in time for the weekend and your multiplayer sessions, we have focused on the Old Race balancing and have an update for you! Here's what we fixed:

[list]
[*] Neutral Armies now don't attack garrisons with units
[*] Hero recruitment was displaying building material instead of secondary faction resource before, now it is correct
[*] Rebalanced Crusade starting resources: 100 Gold, 50 Building Mat, 65 Void
[*] Rebalanced Old Race starting resources: 200 Gold, 150 building mat, 25 Hymn
[*] Bugfix for all units with Area Attacks: now they target the floor under units, there was a mistake in the balancing setup before which caused them to miss a lot
[*] Decreased Ward + Armor chances to block damage
[*] Removed Animate Konstrukt Card from the Konstruktor Card pool, decreased spawn chances for bigger Konstrukts (please note that the chances increase though per Konstruktorium Level and for higher prosperity tiers of the Excavation Site)
[*] Added Pierce 1 to Shunned Flinger unit
[*] Fixed an exposed loca string in the recruit Brigand Cavalry Card
[*] Added units to the rogue prince starting army (both starting hero and base hero)
[*] Added Charge card to the Triune, took away hold the line card
[*] Fixed false icons on the Storage and Supply perks
[*] Increased the range of the Firstborn Militia Line Attack
[*] All konstrukts will cost building material instead of gold (same amount)
[*] Changed the summon konstrukt unit pool (removed Ansturm from lvl 1, removed Worldscar from lvl 2, adjusted weights for all lvls)
[*] Removed stun from Draw Hymn card
[*] Defensive Fire cooldown changed of to 15 from 5
[*] Increased the Hymn costs of recruiting konstrukts, buildings & life node now costs hymn instead of gold
[*] Added missing loca key for Life Node upgrade
[*] Call of Life will heal up to 5/10/15 HP instead of 20
[*] Empower attack speed buff changed from 0.5/0.8/1 to 0.2/0.3/0.5
[*] Triade of Arms will spawn not full units: Garant&Harbinger 4/6/8 and Lorekeeper 2/3/5
[*] Pioneer perk will now reduce not only gold and building mat costs, but also hymn, void, divine favor
[*] Old race enclave prosperity points needed to build up increased to 15(lvl2) and 40 (lvl3)
[*] Old race enclave income changed lvl 2: 25->30 Gold, 22->25 BuildingMat, 7->10 Hymn. Lvl3: 35->45 Gold, 30->35 BuildingMat, 10->17 Hymn

notes.title: We have a date! – December 11, we will update the Songs of Silence Closed Beta!
notes.notes:
Hi Songs of Silence fans! 
Next week, on Monday, December 11, we'll update the Closed Beta, meaning for you, the chance to play brand-new content and help us shaping the game! 
And everybody can join, simply by signing up for it, if you've not already. 

[h3]Disclaimer in advance:[/h3]
Be aware that this is once again a work in progress version of the game.
This means there’ll most likely be bugs, and some things might not be fully implemented (such as text strings), there might be icons missing, or placeholder elements still in some places.  
Overall, some features and mechanics might still be subject to change, be it fine-tuning, balancing, improving, or even some bigger changes going on until the final version’s release! 

[u][b]Please find below a small overview of what to expect: [/b][/u]

[h1]Songs of Silence Closed Beta contents[/h1]
[h3]General [/h3]
[list][*] The new and final main menu with it all 3 main game modes:  
[list][*]Campaign, Singleplayer Skirmish, and Multiplayer[/list]
[*]The new save/load system, which will be version agnostic (meaning save games will be compatible with newer versions).[/list]

[h3]Community Feedback [/h3]
Thanks to your overwhelming feedback during the Closed Beta in Summer and playing the demo, we were also able to add a lot of bugfixes and feedback from you. Please check out some feedback-points, we’ve added based on your feedback: 

[list][*] Space-bar to pause/unpause the battle 
[*] Play combat cards during the paused battle 
[*] Neutral enemy (AI) has been improved 
[*] Skirmish parameters have been added for more control and variety 
[*] You can now select your starting hero before a skirmish game 
[*] Savegames have been worked on 
[*] Now you can see that the game is regularly auto-saving 
[*] Numerous bug-fixes, minor and major improvements, tweaks, fine-tuning, balancing, too many, to list all of them, but be assured, we took all your feedback and reports seriously and could improve a lot. Check it out yourself.[/list]
Additionally, this is just the first round of improvements based on your feedback. There will be more to come, including e.g. the most wished for feature to skip cut-scenes. 
Be assured, there will be more improvements, bugfixes and alike coming down the road, after the Closed Beta kicks of next Monday! So stay tuned, and provide us with your feedback.

[h3]Campaign [/h3]
[list][*] Maps 01 - 03 are now fully playable 
[*] Campaign progression system and map unlock 
[list][*] You can only play Map 02 once you have finished Map 01. 
[*] Plus, you can now take certain things from map to map (e.g. if you finish Map 01 with a hero level of 4 you will start Map 02 with the same level)[/list][/list]

[h3]Skirmish: [/h3]
[list][*] 9 maps per side (light/dark) and all great amount of selection features already enabled. 
[*] Hero selection (only Thousand Kingdoms faction for now) 
[*] Map size selection[/list]

[h3]Multiplayer [/h3]
[list][*] The same skirmish maps are also available in multiplayer.  
[*] And all map setup features are available.  
[*] For now, we are offering only the „Quick Join“ option. Later on, we might include the private match option as well. Stay tuned.[/list]
